item.title: Cue the music: Jensen Huang Resignation and FAA Ground Stop
item.description:
Jensen Huang and allies eye his Nvidia comeback...
Ready, set, hike. The NFL had to call an audible over the weekend, after Friday’s nationwide ground stoppage threatened to keep referees from making it to their scheduled games. As a result, four officials had to pull double duty on Sunday and drive from one game to another. It wasn’t immediately clear whether they would be compensated accordingly because the NFL’s overtime rules are constantly changing.

item.title: Book Brew: Why Physical Books Survived the AI Flood
item.description:
Giving you a read on the literary economy...
Good morning. Like a fifth grader, we are here to deliver a book report. But don’t worry, we won’t be rehashing the plot of a story that we barely read. Instead, in Book Brew, we’ll give you a read on the surprising endurance of bookstores, AI nabbing market share from human authors, book-inspired travel, and which celebrities’ book clubs people are eagerly turning pages for.
